To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the formalization of the foreign exchange processes in the form of a commitment protocol yields an elegant and concise specification of the interactions involved and that the resulting specification is amenable to automated verification.

the use of commitment protocols in the specification of FX business processes results in a simpler and more robust specification of the desired behavior, that the resulting protocols are amenable to automated reasoning, and that the protocols discovered by the approach are more robust than those currently used in practice.

the use of commitment protocols for specifying foreign exchange processes yields a clear, concise specification, and that the resulting specification can be used for automated compliance checking and verification of the business processes.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a formal approach for specifying foreign exchange processes that are based on the standard protocols defined by the TWIST specification.
the formal specification and verification of business interactions.
the development and application of commitment protocols to the foreign exchange business.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
a protocol-based approach to specifying foreign exchange processes provides a more robust basis for implementation and compliance than the traditional approach.
a commitment-based protocol specification is a superior way of specifying FX processes than the traditional approaches.
a commitment-based protocol specification is a superior approach for the specification and validation of FX business processes.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
our approach provides a more robust and efficient specification of FX processes.
our approach provides a formal basis to understand the business processes involved and to verify their conformance with the standards.
the formal approach provides a more rigorous specification of FX business processes, and that this leads to a more complete specification of the business domain, and thus to better implementations.
The main takeaway from our work is that
a protocol-based specification approach is a promising approach to specifying foreign exchange processes.

formalizing the business semantics of a domain leads to better understanding, and that the formal specification of business protocols is a valuable aid in the design of business processes and their implementations.
the formalization of the core protocols is not only useful to ensure that the processes are correctly defined and implemented, but also provides a way to discover new business opportunities.
